title: CMMLU: MEASURING MASSIVE MULTITASK LANGUAGE UNDERSTANDING IN CHINESE
benchmark_measurement: Factual knowledge of major world religions (Islam, Judaism, Buddhism, Christianity).
findings: The 'World Religions' subject was included in the Humanities category, where models generally exhibited strong performance compared to STEM subjects. In the 5-shot evaluation, GPT-4 achieved the highest accuracy at 83.8%, followed by Baichuan2-13B at 73.8% and LLaMA2-70B at 66.9%, indicating a good grasp of factual religious knowledge.
